SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DT.COMPANY_CODE, DT.DIVISION_CODE, DT.IF_HEADER_ID, DT.IF_DETAIL_ID FROM STX_MRO_RFQ_HEADER@STXMFG HD, STX_MRO_RFQ_LINE@STXMFG DT WHERE 1 = 1 AND DT.COMPANY_CODE = HD.COMPANY_CODE AND DT.DIVISION_CODE = HD.DIVISION_CODE AND DT.IF_HEADER_ID = HD.IF_HEADER_ID AND DT.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY DT.COMPANY_CODE, DT.DIVISION_CODE, DT.IF_HEADER_ID, DT.IF_DETAIL_ID
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'STX1' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, DT.DIVISION_CODE AS PLANT, DT.RFQ_NO AS QUOTATION_NO, DT.RFQ_SEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ, '01' AS REVISION, NVL(DT.IF_STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(HD.RFQ_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(DT.RFQ_DELIVERY_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS RD_DATE, DT.ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, DT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION, DT.UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(DT.RFQ_PRICE,0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, TO_CHAR(HD.RFQ_CLOSE_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CLOSE_DATE, TO_CHAR(HD.RFQ_CLOSE_DATE,'HH24MISS') AS CLOSE_TIME, NVL(DT.RFQ_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, DT.BUYER_REMARK AS REMARK, DT.PROJECT_NO ||'^'|| DT.PROJECT_NAME AS ETC_REMARK, DT.COMPANY_CODE ||'^'|| DT.DIVISION_CODE ||'^'|| DT.IF_HEADER_ID ||'^'|| DT.IF_DETAIL_ID AS REF_IF_NO, DT.IF_SYSTEM_ID ||'^'|| DT.RFQ_PO_HEADER_ID ||'^'|| DT.RFQ_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE ||'^'|| DT.RFQ_PO_LINE_ID ||'^'|| DT.RFQ_PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID ||'^'|| DT.RFQ_SHIPMENT_NUM ||'^'|| DT.RFQ_ITEM_ID ||'^'|| DT.RFQ_PROJECT_ID ||'^'|| HD.DELY_TERMS ||'^'|| HD.PAY_TERMS AS REMARK_URL FROM STX_MRO_RFQ_HEADER@STXMFG HD, STX_MRO_RFQ_LINE@STXMFG DT WHERE 1 = 1 AND DT.COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND DT.DIVISION_CODE = '$G_RS.DIVISION_CODE$' AND DT.IF_HEADER_ID = '$G_RS.IF_HEADER_ID$' AND DT.IF_DETAIL_ID = '$G_RS.IF_DETAIL_ID$' AND DT.COMPANY_CODE = HD.COMPANY_CODE AND DT.DIVISION_CODE = HD.DIVISION_CODE AND DT.IF_HEADER_ID = HD.IF_HEADER_ID ORDER BY DT.COMPANY_CODE, DT.DIVISION_CODE, DT.RFQ_NO, DT.RFQ_SEQ
UPDATE STX_MRO_RFQ_LINE@STXMFG DT SET DT.IF_FLAG = 'Y', DT.IF_RECV_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND DT.COMPANY_CODE = '$G_RS.COMPANY_CODE$' AND DT.DIVISION_CODE = '$G_RS.DIVISION_CODE$' AND DT.IF_HEADER_ID = $G_RS.IF_HEADER_ID$ AND DT.IF_DETAIL_ID = $G_RS.IF_DETAIL_ID$
